Saturday Core Shop Ride

Tupelo, MS · Road

No-drop

Saturday Core Shop Ride is a road group ride in Tupelo, MS. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Core Cycle & Outdoor. About 40 miles, no-drop, 20–22 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 20–22 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Saturday Core Shop Ride group ride

A 40-mile no-drop ride from the shop. The pace is quick at 20 to 22 mph average, so it suits riders who can already hold a fast group.
